svg.desc: X is projected three ways into Q, K and V. Q times K transpose gives an n by n score matrix, which is divided by the square root of d_k, masked with minus infinity above the diagonal, and passed through softmax to give attention weights whose rows sum to one. Those weights multiply V to give the output.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One attention operation, end to end

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every arrow is a matrix multiply or an elementwise step. Nothing else happens.

svg.text: for each position, score every other position by how well what I seek matches what it shows;

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: turn those scores into a distribution; take that weighted average of what they give.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The scale and the mask are the only two steps that are not in the one-sentence version -

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and they are the two that decide whether the model trains and whether it cheats.
